These files are copied from Straza's grant spec, spec/grant v1alpha1,
examples, byte for byte. TestGrantSpecExamples in git_grant_spec_test.go
replays them against ghapp's verifier. Each file's own provenance member
says how it was made, and sha256sum shows the copies are whole:

When the spec's examples change, copy the folder again, update the table
above, and add any new file to the table in TestGrantSpecExamples, which
fails on a file it does not know.
